_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: momentum/funding/DXY never hit crash extremes and rangebound tape keeps score pinned in Anxiety band.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative simply weaker/awaiting
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear stays ~30-45, 30d momentum near 50, BTC rangebound, no ±2 score break next sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear under ~24 with funding negative (down to Denial) or momentum/spot bid lifts score through ~47 (up to Complacency)
